2607.24717.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
2607.24717.paper_summary: Pretraining data processing is critical to the downstream performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, many existing approaches define a fixed processing strategy at the corpus or domain level and apply it uniformly to many examples, without adapting to the needs of each example. We propose DataOrchestra, a framework that unifies different processing operations and orchestrates an example-specific pipeline for each example. Given a chunk of pretraining data, an orchestrator decides whether to drop, untouch, or clean it. For a chunk to be cleaned, it selects one or more downstream operations, ranging from programmatic editing to different forms of LLM-based rewriting. For each rewriting step, it further generates a concrete instruction, which is executed by the corresponding downstream tool model. We pretrain models from 0.5B to 7B from scratch on web data processed by DataOrchestra and observe stable average gains over individual data-processing methods across 11 benchmarks. DataOrchestra is also effective for math continued pretraining and outperforms stronger processing baselines, while reducing processing compute by skipping unnecessary downstream operations.
2607.24717.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練數據處理對大型語言模型（LLMs）的下游性能至關重要。<lb/>然而，許多現有的方法在語料庫或領域層面定義了一種固定的處理策略，並對許多示例統一應用，而沒有根據每個示例的需求進行調整。<lb/>我們提出了DataOrchestra，一個統一不同處理操作的框架，並為每個示例協調一個特定的管道。<lb/>給定一塊預訓練數據，協調者決定是丟棄、保持不變還是清理它。<lb/>為了清理一塊數據，它選擇一個或多個下游操作，範圍從程序編輯到不同形式的基於LLM的重寫。<lb/>對於每個重寫步驟，它進一步生成具體的指令，這些指令由相應的下游工具模型執行。<lb/>我們從0.5B到7B的模型在通過DataOrchestra處理的網絡數據上從零開始進行預訓練，並在11個基準測試中觀察到相對於個別數據處理方法的穩定平均增益。<lb/>DataOrchestra在數學持續預訓練中也有效，並且超越了更強的處理基準，同時通過跳過不必要的下游操作來減少處理計算。
